problem: Production pricing loaded i18n assets but the active v18 mobile drawer contained zero language selectors.
root_cause: tools/site-shell/apply-i18n.mjs returned for the entire page when data-bg-i18n-asset was already present. Pricing intentionally carries those assets in source, so the later build never executed injectMobileLanguage against the generated v18 drawer.
prevention: Separate asset injection idempotency from mobile-control injection idempotency.
Existing i18n assets must never short-circuit structural language-control repair.
Write the HTML only when output actually changes.
Production browser proof must observe at least one visible language select in the active v18 drawer and complete NL→EN→NL.
